stories.headline: Korea divided: A sister’s long wait and a defector’s bid to save his mother
stories.description: An elderly South Korean waits to see a brother in the North one last time, while a North Korean defector risks it all.

stories.headline: Israeli settlers surround Palestinian home in occupied West Bank’s Qusra
stories.description: At least four Palestinians are trapped inside the home, while settlers have set fire to nearby Palestinian land.

stories.headline: UNRWA’s first and last vocational college in East Jerusalem is under threat
stories.description: Israel threatens the Qalandiya Training Centre, one of Jerusalem’s oldest still-operational educational institutions.

stories.headline: Royal Navy warships and helicopter track Russian vessels in three-day operation
stories.description: Royal Navy ships monitored four Russian vessels in the North Sea and English Channel last week.

stories.headline: At least 37 dead and hundreds evacuated after strike on Kyiv warehouse
stories.description: An investigation has been launched into the storage of weapons in the deopt near a residential area.
